📍Eindhoven (5 days in office) | 🗓️ 40hrs per week
🚀 This is what you tell people at parties
We didn't become Europe's leading e-commerce shipping platform by playing it safe. Sendcloud powers 30,000+ online retailers, marketplaces, and fulfillment companies. Helping them ship smarter, grow faster, and actually get shit done for their customers. Boring logistics? Not here. We're building the platform that solves shipping, at scale, globally!
🧐 The Role
Sendcloud is the leading shipping platform for e-commerce in Europe, helping over 30,000 merchants save time and money on logistics. Our Eindhoven HQ is where the team comes together, and this role keeps it running.
You serve as the right hand of the House of Talent Team at Sendcloud. The House of Talent covers all matters in HR (recruitment, admin, talent partnering, office management, etc). Roughly half your week goes to helping out keeping our office in shape and organizing internal events, half goes to supporting our HR team, staying on top of administration and helping answer employee questions. No two days look the same: you might restock the pantry in the morning, prepare a contract after lunch and set up a team lunch before you leave. If you had a slogan, it would be: "Already taken care of."
🎯 What you'll do
Keep the office running (about 50%)
Keep the office, meeting rooms and kitchens tidy and guest-ready. We have a cleaning team so you will not be an in-house cleaner, but you don’t shy away from rolling up your sleeves when needed.
Restock coffee, snacks and supplies, and work with the office manager or stack up on supplies yourself.
Be the first stop for everyday office needs: meeting rooms, post, deliveries and small facility issues.
Support the Office Manager with day-to-day tasks.
Welcome visitors, newbies and candidates when the Office Manager is not available.
Help plan and run company events with the HOT team: anniversary celebrations, newbie sessions, Friday afternoon drinks, company parties or come up with your own fun celebrations for our office.
Own smaller events end to end: team lunches, seasonal moments and smaller celebrations. Book, cater, invite, set up and clean up.
Support HR admin (about 50%)
Prepare contracts, amendments and letters from our templates. The Talent Ops Specialist supports you in making sure things are good before they get sent out.
Run the admin side of onboarding: collect documents, send welcome info and get IT and the office ready for day one.
Keep lifecycle data up to date, from probation and renewals to offboarding paperwork.
Keep employee records accurate and confidential.
Answer everyday HR questions from colleagues and pass the tricky ones to the right person.
Improve how we work
Spot small improvements to templates, checklists and office routines, and suggest them.
✅ What you bring to the table
Personally
You are detail-oriented: you spot the typo or missing signature before anyone else.
You are service-minded, proactive and notice what needs doing without being asked.
You are discreet. People trust you with confidential information.
You stay calm when several things land at once.
You suggest a better way instead of waiting to be asked.
Professionally
You are looking for a graduation internship in a field like HR, business administration, law, hospitality or communications.
You are fluent in English, spoken and written. Dutch is a plus, not a requirement.
You live in or near Eindhoven and can be in the office 5 days a week.
You are comfortable or can get up to speed fast with tools like Google Workspace and Slack.
A plus: experience with admin or events (student societies count), or basic knowledge of labour law.
How we work
You are never on your own. The Office Manager and the Talent Ops Specialist guide your day to day, and the whole HOT team supports you. You get real ownership early: small events and recurring office routines are yours from the start. You see how HR and office operations work in a fast-growing European scale-up.
❤️ Our Values
💩 No bullshit: Big egos suck. Be open, honest and transparent. Share your mistakes openly and learn from them. Don’t just talk about problems, solve them.
🎯 Grow & win: Be highly curious, adaptable & proactive. Embrace discomfort and change. Keep an open mindset and learn from others. You invest in our growth, so we invest in yours.
🎠 Have fun: Work hard, laugh harder. Not everything has to be serious. Be yourself, especially if you’re the good kind of crazy. Sendcloud is an adventure, not a corporate maze, enjoy the ride.
🎉 Benefits
💸 Internship Allowance - €500 per month for HBO level, €750 for WO level (based on 40 hours)
💪 Body Benefits - Company gym · Free lunch every Monday · Fresh fruit · Barista coffee
🚌 Travel Benefits - Monthly commuting allowance
🐾 Vibe Benefits - Dog-friendly office · After-hours drinks at the Sendcloud Bar
